mist.$description: Mist — Card surfaces, placeholder image wells, subtle inset zones

chalk.$description: Chalk — Elevated card surfaces when differentiation from Plaster is needed

hairline.$description: Hairline — Stronger dividers, disabled icon strokes, secondary borders

inkstone.$description: Inkstone — Primary heading text, high-emphasis body copy, nav logo wordmark

slate.$description: Slate — Secondary headings, medium-emphasis text, icon strokes

graphite.$description: Graphite — Body text, nav links, button labels — the everyday workhorse neutral

pewter.$description: Pewter — Muted helper text, secondary links, metadata

fog.$description: Fog — Disabled state text, tertiary captions, low-emphasis labels

obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Maximum-contrast text where #0f172a still feels too soft (rare)

spark-violet.$description: Spark Violet — Wordmark icon and the sole chromatic accent in the entire system — used at the smallest possible size to mark the brand without coloring the interface

greycliff.$description: Single-family system. Weight 300 carries display (60px) and large headings (36px) for a quiet, editorial whisper. Weight 400–500 handles body (16–18px) and UI labels. Weight 600–700 reserved for emphasis and the wordmark. Because there is no secondary face, the system creates rhythm purely through weight and size contrast inside one typeface.
